title: RoRA: Role-Oriented Regional Allocation for Visual Token Pruning in MLLMs
selection_reason: RoRA allocates visual-token budgets by semantic regions and reports 24.6% lower end-to-end MLLM inference time at 66.7% pruning on H800.
